scanner.name: Complete scanner workflow
scanner.steps: Submit the controlled website; finish crawling; check errors, skipped downloads and a failed page; print the report.

navigation.name: Finding navigation and complete printing
navigation.steps: Open a spelling finding, jump forwards and backwards, then inspect the full print report.

mobile.name: Mobile map, inventory and tools
mobile.steps: Open a 38-page map at 320–750px; search and collapse branches; open details; check inventory and every workspace panel.

workspace.name: Saved scans, email, reviews and monitoring
workspace.steps: Save two scans; check email; share a page with another browser; post feedback; run scheduled monitoring; reload the workspace.

live-site.name: Deployed Site Knight desktop and mobile
live-site.steps: Open deployed Site Knight; inspect scan controls and all tools at desktop and phone widths.

permaloc.name: Permaloc live page sample
permaloc.steps: Ask the deployed scanner to load two saved Permaloc URLs; inspect returned HTML and reject CAD documents as pages. This is a sample, not a full crawl.

self-check.name: Tester detects a deliberate failure
self-check.steps: Remove the known fixture spelling error; verify the assertion fails, exits nonzero and captures a screenshot. This expected failure must be caught for the self-check to pass.

runner.name: Batch timeouts, honest reports and failed-only retry
runner.steps: Run controlled passing, failing, hanging and incomplete tests. Repair failures and verify only failed checks rerun. Verify setup failures stay Not tested.

reliability.name: Complete scanner reliability matrix
reliability.steps: Submit ten complete controlled scans covering ordinary HTML, several JavaScript patterns, client routing, public browser recovery, authentication, temporary limits and blocked content.

crawl-ntc.name: NTC complete live workflow
crawl-ntc.steps: Run the complete discovered-site scan, then verify mobile map and printed report.

crawl-static.name: Static site complete workflow
crawl-static.steps: Run the complete discovered-site scan, then verify mobile map and printed report.

crawl-js.name: JavaScript site crawl sample
crawl-js.steps: Run an explicitly bounded live crawl, then verify mobile map and printed report. Coverage records all checked, failed and unverified pages.

crawl-wordpress.name: WordPress crawl sample
crawl-wordpress.steps: Run an explicitly bounded live crawl, then verify mobile map and printed report. Coverage records all checked, failed and unverified pages.

responses.name: Response truth and bounded link verification
responses.steps: Verify that HTTP 200 security screens, soft 404s and HTML at image URLs cannot pass as healthy destinations; confirm normal pages and real 404s.

daily-mozilla.name: Rotating audit: Corporate and product website
daily-mozilla.steps: Run the scanner on an unfamiliar public website, pause after three checked pages while finishing in-flight work, verify mobile content map and complete report output. Explicitly report blocked/unverified coverage.

daily-govuk.name: Rotating audit: Public-sector website
daily-govuk.steps: Run the scanner on an unfamiliar public website, pause after three checked pages while finishing in-flight work, verify mobile content map and complete report output. Explicitly report blocked/unverified coverage.

budget.name: Total page deadlines and responsive stopping
budget.steps: Verify that retries share one total page budget, temporary limits recover, cancellation is immediate, and paused/cancelled scans never start queued destinations.

metadata.name: Metadata previews, indexing and structured data
metadata.steps: Inspect declared favicon, search/social cards, business graph, malformed JSON-LD, duplicate metadata, public asset URLs, mobile width, full print report, site files and browser metadata preservation.
